thread:
Maria P: Quick design review — I pushed a new Figma for the billing panel: org/project hierarchy + invoice rows. Wanted to get quick takes before the Friday sync. https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/billing-panel
Alex W: Nice! First thought — the scope selector feels heavy. Do we prefer a breadcrumb + inline scope (Org > Project) or a single compact dropdown? Breadcrumb helps orientation but uses more real estate.
Jon C: Breadcrumb = more DOM nodes, might slow initial render on large orgs. Also think about virtualizing the invoice rows rather than expanding every item by default. :thinking_face:
Emma L: From usage data I pulled last week, ~78% of queries are at the org level. So defaulting to org makes sense, but we should make it obvious how to drill into projects. Maybe collapsed project list with a single CTA to "View project spend".
Maria P: Good data context. UX asks: how does the token breakdown live with this? We currently show token split inline per invoice row. If we virtualize rows that won't fly. Proposal: keep compact token badge summary on rows and open a right-side flyout with full token timeline + per-route breakdown.
Alex W: Flyout sounds good. Micro-interaction nit: when flyout opens, focus should land inside for keyboard users and screen readers. Also escape should close it and return focus to the row.
DesignBot: Accessibility checklist reminder:
- Ensure role="dialog" + aria-modal="true"
- Keyboard focus trap
- Descriptive aria-labels for scope selector
- Color contrast for token badges >= 4.5:1
Example aria snippet for the scope button:
```
<button aria-label="Open billing scope selector" id="billing-scope">Org ▾</button>
```
Maria P: Copy nits: current mock uses "Account" and "Workspace" — that's ambiguous for self-serve customers. Suggest we use "Organization" and "Project" consistently. Also change CTA "Download" to "Download invoice (CSV)" for clarity.
Jon C: Agree on copy. Also performance note: if flyout fetches token timelines, do a streaming fetch and show skeleton while loading. We can reuse existing /billing/tokens endpoint.
Emma L: UX question: invoice table height — do we want density toggles (Compact / Comfortable)? We have space constraints on small screens. If we add density toggle, remember to persist it per user.
Alex W: Can we add a small inline sparkline for token trend on each invoice row? Tiny, low-cost SVG. Helps spot regressions at glance. But hide for screen reader (aria-hidden) and provide textual alt: "tokens: +12% vs last period".
Maria P: Action items:
- Alex: prototype flyout focus behaviour + sparkline hidden-for-a11y (due Tue)
- Jon: virtualize invoice rows + streaming token fetch (Wed)
- Emma: update analytics to include project-drill clicks (metrics event: billing.project_drill) (Thu)
- Design: finalize copy changes (Organization / Project / Download invoice (CSV)) and push to Figma (Mon)
PM-Bot: Noted. I'll add tasks in the backlog and link PRs to the ticket.
Maria P: Thanks everyone. Quick poll: :eyes: react if you prefer breadcrumb, :thumbsup: for dropdown. Share reaction in thread so I can capture vote.
Alex W: :thumbsup:
Jon C: :eyes:
Emma L: :thumbsup:
DesignBot: :thumbsup:
